body: Minimal flat-vector logo on a charcoal square. Center a copper campfire emblem above the cream geometric wordmark "EMBER". Keep the wordmark and side logs perfectly still. Only the center flame tongue flickers upward a few pixels and returns to its starting silhouette. Locked front view, crisp flat colors.
